title: Iran-Backed Houthis Strike Presidential Palace, Yemen Says
summary: Two were killed when Houthi missiles struck the Maashiq Presidential Palace in Aden, a Yemeni minister said. Saudi Arabia has said Iran is fueling the country’s escalating conflict.
